newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian fishermen end blockade of U.S. ferry.
newsitem.headline: Canadian fishermen end blockade of U.S. ferry.

text.p: Canadian fishermen ended a three-day blockade of an Alaska ferry on Monday after Ottawa assured them it would try to resolve a dispute between Canada and the United States over salmon fishing.

Officials said fishing boats were dispersing from around the Alaska state ferry Malaspina in Prince Rupert, about 1,000 miles (1,600 km) north of Vancouver. A flotilla of up to 400 fishing boats had prevented the ferry from leaving port since Saturday.
